index.meaning.title: “GGanbu” kusho umngane osondelene nofuthi okwethembekile.
index.meaning.lead: “GGanbu” kusho umngane osondelene nofuthi okwethembekile—umuntu ongakhuluma naye ngokukhululeka futhi omphatha ngoconde.
index.meaning.p3: Akukho ukuhlanganiswa okungahleliwe noma ingcindezi yokuphendula
index.features.title: Ubuchwepheshe obulula. Uxhumano lwabantu.
index.features.lead: I-GGanbu Chat igcina ukuxhumana okuseduze kuqonde futhi ikunikeze amathuluzi ayizwe okuxhumana ngendlela ecophelelayo.
index.feat.1.d: I-Bluetooth Low Energy isiza amadivayisi aseduze ukuba atholane futhi axhumane ngqo. Izingxoxo eziyisisekelo azidluli ku-server yengxoxo ephakathi.
index.feat.2.d: Sebenzisa i-endpoint ehleliwe ehambisana ne-Ollama ukuze ubone imilayezo yokuqala neyihumushiwe ndawonye futhi wenze ingxoxo ibe lula.
index.feat.3.d: I-iOS ne-Android zisebenzisa i-protocol efanayo yeseduze, ngakho abantu abaseduze nawe abahlukaniswa ukukhetha kwabo ucingo.
index.feat.4.d: Uma uthando lwabangani luyashayisana, uba yi-GGanbu—abangane abathembekile abakhethile ukuhlala baxhumene.
index.feat.5.d: Thumela izithombe kanye nombhalo ngokuqondile nge-Bluetooth, futhi hlanganyela izikhathi zansuku zonke nabantu obathembayo.
index.feat.6.d: Khetha ukuthi nini ungatholakala, sula izingxoxo zasendaweni, futhi uvimbe noma ubike abasebenzisi abahlukumezayo. I-GGanbu Chat ngeyabantu abadala abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu.
index.how.title: Uhlala ulawula konke kusukela ekubingeleleni.
index.how.lead: Lungisa iphrofayili, khetha ukuthi nini ungabonakala, futhi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukukhuluma nobani.
index.step.1.d: Dala iphrofayili, nikeza imvume edingekayo yokuxhumana kwabasebenzi abaseduze, futhi ukhethe ukuthi nini ungatholakala.
index.step.2.d: Abadala abatholakala ekhefi elilodwa, emtapo lwencwadi, emcimbeni, noma endaweni ehlanganyelwe, bavele ngokusebenzisa ukusondela kwe-Bluetooth.
index.step.3.d: Khetha iphrofayili eseduze bese uqala ingxoxo eqondile. Ukuhumusha okukhethwayo kungasiza abantu bobabili ukuba bazizwe beqondwa.
index.lang.title: Izilimi ezehlukene zingase zizizwe zisisondele.
index.lang.lead: Uma i-translation endpoint ehambelanayo isethiwe, i-GGanbu Chat ingasiza ekuhumusheni izingxoxo kanti umlayezo wokuqala uhlala ubonakala.
index.dl.title: i-GGanbu yakho elandelayo ingase ibe seduze.
index.dl.lead: Landa i-GGanbu Chat ku-iOS noma ku-Android bese uxhumana nabantu abaseduze ngendlela ehloniphayo neyinomsindo. Kubantu abadala iminyaka engu-18+.

privacy.meta.title: Imithetho yoBumfihlo — GGanbu Chat
privacy.title: Inqubo Yobumfihlo
privacy.intro: I-GGanbu Chat ("i-app," "thina," noma "ethu") iwuhlelo lokuxhumana oluseduze oluhlinzekwa umthuthukisi ochazwe ohlelweni lwayo lwe-app-store. Izingxoxo eziyisisekelo zishintshiselwana ngqo phakathi kwama-device usebenzisa i-Bluetooth kunokuba kube nge-server yezingxoxo ephakathi. Eminye imisebenzi ekhethwayo, okuhlanganisa ukuhumusha, imibiko yokuphepha, nokuthenga ku-app, isebenzisa izinsizwa zenetwork noma zeplatform njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Le Nqubo Yobumfihlo ichaza ukuthi yimuphi ulwazi oluphathwayo, ukuthi kungani lusetshenziswa, ukuthi lungahlanganyelwa nobani, isikhathi esigcinwa ngaso, kanye nezinketho ezitholakala kuwe.
privacy.s1.p: Kuye ngezici ozikhethayo, i-app ilawula lezi zigaba zolwazi ezilandelayo:
privacy.s1.l1: Umlando kanye nolwazi lokuxhumana — igama lakho elibonakalayo futhi, uma ukhetha ukuwalinikeza, isithombe somlando nekheli le-email. Umlando wakho ubonakala kubasebenzisi abaseduze ngenkathi ungatholakala. I-email yakho ingahlanganyelwa nomunye umsebenzisi kuphela ngemuva kokuba kube nokuthakasela kwabo bobabili kwe-GGanbu, futhi ingafakwa embikweni wokuphepha okukhetha ukusithumela.
privacy.s1.l2: Okuqukethwe komsebenzisi — imilayezo nezithombe oshintshiselwana ngazo zigcinwa kuma-device ahambisana nalokhu futhi zithunyelwa ngqo nge-Bluetooth. Uma uthumela umbiko wokuphepha, umbiko ungakuhlanganisa umlayezo obikwe, isimo sengxoxo yakamuva, nezithombe ezitholwe kumsebenzisi obikwe.
privacy.s1.l3: Ulwazi lwedevayisi nokusondelana — isiboneleli se-app esikhiqizwa ngokuhlukumezeka sahlukanisa abasebenzisi abaseduze. Amandla wesignali ye-Bluetooth (RSSI) asetshenziswa ukukala ukusondelana. I-app ayisebenzisi i-RSSI ukuze ithole noma igcine izinkcoords ze-GPS.
privacy.s1.l4: Ulwazi lombiko, lwe-app, nolwethenga — umbiko ungakuhlanganisa amagama abika nomsebenzisi obikwe, i-email yobikayo, isizathu nesikhathi sombiko, uhlobo lwe-app, kanye nekopi efakwe i-encryption yesiboneleli se-app somsebenzisi obikwe. I-Apple noma i-Google zingahlinzeka isimo sokuthenga neziboneleli ze-transaction ezidingekayo ukuze kuqedwe noma kubuyiselwe ukuthenga ku-app.
privacy.s2.t: 2. Indlela esisebenzisa ngayo futhi esabelana ngayo ngolwazi
privacy.s2.p: Sisebenzisa ulwazi kuphela ukuze sinikeze ukutholakala kwemishini eseduze nokuxhumana phakathi kwemishini, ukwenza uhumusho olucelwe yini, ukuqedela ukuthenga, ukuvimba ukusebenzisa kabi, ukuphendula imibiko nezicelo zoseziso, nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ulwazi lwephrofayili okuqukethwe kwezingxoxo lusabelwana nabasebenzisi abaseduze okukhethile ukuxhumana nabo. Umbhalo wohumusho usabelwana ne-translation endpoint oyilungisile; ulwazi lokuthenga luphathwa yi-Apple noma i-Google; kanti ulwazi lwemibiko luthunyelwa ngomhlinzeki wakho we-imeyili okhethelele ku-safety contact yethu. Lapho sikhetha umhlinzeki wenkonzo ukuze acubungule ulwazi lwakithi, sidinga ukuvikelwa kobumfihlo okuhambisana nale nqubo; izinkonzo ozikhethelele wena zilawulwa yimigomo nemikhuba yobumfihlo yazo. Asithengisi ulwazi lwabantu, alulusebenziseli ukukhangisa kwabanye, futhi asisebenzi ngezinhlelo ze-SDK zokukhangisa noma zokulandelela phakathi kwezinhlelo (cross-app tracking). Asitholi amakhophi ajwayelekile ezingxoxo eziqondile kuserver yezingxoxo eyodwa.
privacy.s3.l1: Bluetooth / Amadivayisi aseduze — isetshenziselwa ukuthola, ukukhangisa, ukuxhumana, nokushintshisana okuqukethwe namadivayisi aseduze. Lezi mvume zibalulekile emsebenzini oyinhloko wohlelo (app) futhi zingasususwa kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
privacy.s3.l2: Indawo (Android 11 nangaphambilini) — amadivayisi e-Android amadala adinga imvume yendawo ukuze kwenziwe i-Bluetooth scanning. Kuma-version athuthukile asekelwayo, uhlelo lucela imvume yamadivayisi aseduze futhi lishumayela ukuthi i-Bluetooth scanning ayisetshenziselwa ukuthola indawo yomzimba. Asiqoqi futhi asithumele izinkukudla ze-GPS.
privacy.s3.l3: Izithombe nezaziso — uhlelo lungena kuphela ezithombeni ozikhethele lwephrofayili noma ingxoxo. Imvume yezaziso isetshenziselwa ukukwazisa ngemilayezo nokusekela ukusebenza kwe-Bluetooth lapho isistimu yokusebenza ikudinga khona. Ungenqaba noma ususe imvume ekhethekile kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
privacy.s3.l4: Ukutholakala — wena unquma ukuthi nini ubenze ibhrofayili yakho ibonakale kubasebenzisi abaseduze. Lapho kuvunyelwe, uhlelo lukhangisa ulwazi lwephrofayili oludingekayo ukuze kutholakale i-Bluetooth. Ungaqeda ukutholakala noma nini ngokusebenzisa i-antenna control. Uhlelo alukubeki kwimephu noma lukuhlanganise ngendlela engahleliwe engxoxweni.
privacy.s4.p: Uhumusho kuyinketho futhi ludinga ukufinyelela ku-Ollama-compatible endpoint elungiswe ohlelweni. Lapho ucela uhumusho, umbhalo womlayezo, imiyalelo yohumusho, ulimi oluhleliwe, nesicelo se-model kuthunyelwa kulowo endpoint nge-network yasendaweni noma i-internet, kuye ekhelini owalilungisile. Umphathi we-endpoint angase athole nolwazi lwe-network olujwayelekile njenge-IP address yakho futhi unomthwalo wemisebenzi yokuvikela, ukugcina amarekhodi (logging), ukugcina ulwazi, nemikhuba yobumfihlo yakhe. Asilawuli ama-endpoint akhethiwe ngabasebenzisi. Ingxoxo eqondile ye-Bluetooth ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kohumusho lapho kungekho endpoint etholakala.
privacy.s5.t: 5. Ukugcina, Ezokuphepha, Ukugcinwa kwezixazululo, kanye Nokususa
privacy.s5.p: Iphrofayili, izingxoxo, ukublokha, nomiso ohlongozwe uhlelo (app-generated identifier) ngokuvamile zigcinwa kudivayisi yakho isikhathi eside uhlelo noma irekhodi elifanele lisasekhona. Ukuvikelwa kwedivayisi kwe-operating system kuvikela idatha yohlelo yasendaweni. Ukuphepha kokudluliswa kwe-Bluetooth nenethiwekhi kuncike futhi emishinini ebandakanyekayo, ku-endpoint elungiswe, kunethiwekhi, nomhlinzeki we-imeyili. Akukho ndlela yokugcina noma yokudlulisa idatha ephephile ngokuphelele.
privacy.s5.l1: Susa ingxoxo — isusa leyo ngxoxo kudivayisi yakho. Ayisusi amakhophi asevele atholwe, agcinwe, noma abikwe omunye umsebenzisi.
privacy.s5.l2: Vala umsebenzisi — igcina ukuvala kudivayisi yakho futhi ivimbele ukubonakala kwephrofayili kanye nokuxhumana okuza kulelo gama lokuzwa le-app. Ungaphatha abasebenzisi abavalwe ku-app.
privacy.s5.l3: Thumela isikhalo — kuqala kuvala umsebenzisi obikawe, bese kuvula udraft we-imeyili ukuze uyibuyekeze. Uma uyithumela, isikhalo nanoma yiziphi izobufakazi ezikhethiwe zidluliswa ngomnikezeli wakho we-imeyili ku-safety contact yethu. Igama lokuzwa le-app ebikawe lishifthwe (encrypted) ukuze kube ngokuze kube ngomthuthukisi, kanti umzimba we-imeyili ne-archive yezithombe ziphathwa ngaphansi kwezvikelo zomnikezeli wakho we-imeyili. Sigcina izikhalo kuphela lapho kunenhloso efanele yokuphenya, ukuqinisekisa imithetho yethu, ukuvikela abasebenzisi, ukuxazulula imibango, nokuhlangabezana nezimiso zomthetho, emva kwalokho zisuswa noma zenziwe zingabonakali.
privacy.s5.l4: Susa noma ucele ukusulwa — ukususa (uninstall) ngokujwayelekile kususa idatha ye-app kudivayisi yakho, kuncike ekubuyiselweni kwe-operating system noma amakhophi agcinwe abamukeli nabahlinzeki bezinkonzo. Njengoba ingenalo i-akhawunti ye-app, ayikho i-akhawunti yeseva okumele isulwe. Ukuze ucele ukusulwa kwesikhalo noma irekhodi lexhaso esililawula, xhumana nathi ngezansi; singase sigcine imininingwane lapho kufuneka ngokomthetho noma kubalulekile ukuvikela nokuvimbela ukukhwabanisa.
privacy.s6.p: Ukuthenga ku-app kucutshungulwa yi-Apple App Store noma i-Google Play ngaphansi kwemigomo nenqubo yobumfihlo yeplatifomu. Asitholi futhi asigcini inombolo yakho yephakethe ephelele noma eminye imininingwane yokukhokha. I-app nesitolo zingashintshisana ngemininingwane yomkhiqizo, ukunakekelwa kwe-transaction, isimo sokuthenga, nemininingwane ehlobene nedivayisi/i-akhawunti edingekayo ukuze icutshungulwe, iqinisekiswe, isetshenziswe, noma ibuyiselwe.
privacy.s7.p: I-app ihloselwe kubantu abadala abaneminyaka engu-18 nengaphezulu kuphela. Ayiqondiswe ezinganeni, futhi noma ubani ongeminyaka engu-18 akufanele ayisebenzise. Uma ukholelwa ukuthi ingane inikeze imininingwane ngesikhalo noma isicelo sexhaso, xhumana nathi ukuze siphenye futhi siyisuse lapho kufanele.
privacy.s8.p: Ungabuka noma uhlela iphrofayili yakho, ukhise ukubonakala, ususe imvume, uphathe abasebenzisi abavalwe, ususe izingxoxo, uyeke ukusebenzisa i-translation endpoint, noma ususe i-app. Kuncike ekutheni uhlala kuphi, ungase ube namalungelo okufunda, ukulungisa, ukusula, ukukhawula, ukuphikisa, noma uthole ikhophi yemininingwane yakho siyilawulayo, nokuthatha imvume ngaphandle kokuba nomthelela ekucutshungulweni kwangaphambilini. Xhumana nathi ukuze usebenzise amalungelo afanele. Ungaphinde ubike ezitheni zakho zokuvikela idatha zasendaweni. Singase sidinge ukuqinisekisa isicelo ngaphambi kokuba sisebenze.
privacy.s9.p: Singase sishintshe le nqubo lapho i-app, izindlela zethu zokusebenza, noma izimiso zomthetho zishintsha. Sizofaka inqubo ebuyekiziwe lapha futhi sivuselele usuku olungenhla. Uma ushintsho lunomthelela omkhulu endleleni esisebenzisa ngayo imininingwane, sizohlinzeka nanoma yikuphi ukwaziswa okwengeziwe noma imvume edingekayo ngokomthetho.
privacy.s10.p: Uma unemibuzo mayelana nePolicy yobumfihlo, sicela uxhumane nathi ku:
